blocks.text: 【2 in 1 Tablet】The tablet comes with a Bluetooth keyboard, wireless mouse, and foldable protective case, allowing you to flexibly transform the tablets into laptop mode or computer mode.The package includes: 1 x 10.1 inch tablet, 1 x keyboard, 1 x mouse, 1 x stylus pen, 1 x foldable protective case, 1 x USB-C charger cable.

items: 【Latest Android Tablet】This android tablet features 18GB RAM(Including 12GB of expandable memory) 128GB ROM, android 15 OS and a 10.1" IPS screen, its smooth operation enables seamless video playback, gaming, and multitasking. With ample storage capacity that can be expanded up to 2TB via microSD card (sold separately), you can confidently store all your photos, videos and files without concerns.

【2 in 1 Tablet with Keyboard Mouse And More】This Android 15 tablet package is a perfect combination, 10 inch Tablet connect with a wireless keyboard and mouse, with a protective case, flexible stylus, 2 in 1 tablet Suitable for various usage scenarios, can meet all your needs.

【WiFi 6+Bluetooth 5.0 】 The 10 inch Android tablet adopts the latest sixth generation WiFi technology and upgraded Bluetooth 5.0. The full frequency integrated chip makes 5G WiFi6 and 2.4G WiFi more stable, and the latest Bluetooth 5.0 connection supports all your favorite accessories, greatly improving data transmission speed, increasing network capacity, and reducing network latency.

【IPS Display & Dual Camera】- Equipped with 10.1" IPS 1280x800 HD screen, 2.0MP front camera/8.0MP rear camera, this android 15 tablet offers you a delightful experience while watching movies, reading books, or making video calls.
【Long Battery Life】Built-in 6000mAh lithium battery, this android tablet provides up to 8 hours of uninterrupted video playback, enabling you to use it for longer periods without any interruptions.
